device.description: The device path for the Mellanox HCA or switch flash interface.

image.description: Path to the firmware binary image file for burning or verification.

yes.description: Run in non-interactive mode, assuming 'yes' to all questions.

guid.description: Base GUID value. 4 GUIDs are automatically derived and assigned to node, port1, port2, and system image.

guids.description: List of 4 explicit GUIDs assigned to node, port1, port2, and system image. Overrides 'guid'.

mac.description: Base MAC address value. 2 MACs are automatically derived and assigned to port1 and port2.

macs.description: List of 2 explicit MAC addresses assigned to port1 and port2. Overrides 'mac'. Applicable only for Ethernet products.

vsd.description: Vendor Specific Data string to write to the device during burn (up to 208 chars).

no_flash_verify.description: Do not verify each write on the flash.

log.description: Path to a log file to print burning status to.

use_fw.description: Flash access will be done using FW (ConnectX-3/ConnectX-3Pro only).

allow_rom_change.description: Allow burning/removing a ROM to/from FW image when product version is present.

blank_guids.description: Burn the image with blank GUIDs and MACs.

banks.description: Set the number of attached flash devices (banks).

striped_image.description: Indicate that the given image file is in a 'striped image' format.

override_cache_replacement.description: Allow accessing the flash even if the cache replacement mode is enabled (SwitchX/ConnectIB).

qq.description: Run a quick query without full image integrity checks.

low_cpu.description: Reduce CPU usage at the cost of increased run time.

flashed_version.description: Only fetch the flashed firmware version.

nofs.description: Burn image in a non failsafe manner.

no_fw_ctrl.description: Do not attempt to work with the FW Ctrl update commands.

dual_image.description: Burn two images on flash (previously default algorithm).

use_image_ps.description: Burn VSD as it appears in the given image.

use_image_guids.description: Burn GUIDs/MACs as they appear in the given image.

use_image_rom.description: Do not save the ROM which exists in the device.

use_dev_rom.description: Save the ROM which exists in the device.

ignore_dev_data.description: Do not take device data sections from device (taken from image instead).
